newsitem.title: USA: North Sea Brent mostly up in late U.S. paper deals.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Brent mostly up in late U.S. paper deals.

text.p: North Sea Brent was mostly stronger in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, traders said.
A full boat of June Brent changed hands at $18.30 a barrel, up four cents from the IPE close in London.
Six partial cargoes traded, twice at $18.28, three times at $18.25 and once at $18.31.
June/July Brent was dealt at minus eight cents, a penny stronger than a trade earlier today.
May/June was pegged at minus 19 to minus 15 cents, while July/August was around minus nine to minus six.
